newsitem.title: USA: Tel-Com Wireless names creditor as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Tel-Com Wireless names creditor as CEO.

text.p: Tel-Com Wireless Cable TV Corp said Wednesday its major creditor, Melvin Rosen, had been appointed president and chief executive officer, and Tel-Com had restructured its $2 million debt to him.
Tel-Com said in a statement that Rosen's appointment had been made by the board of directors and was effective immediately.

It said the debt had been restructured as a convertible debenture maturing in 12 months, half of which may be extended for an additional 12 months at the company's option. The debenture is convertible into Tel-Com common stock.
As consideration for agreeing to restructure the debt, Rosen received 180,000 common shares, plus warrants to purchase additional shares, Tel-Com said.
Tel-Com is an owner and operator of wireless cable television systems in Costa Rica and the United States.
